def status(out):
    """Reduce an event outcome to its ok/error status."""
    if 'ok' in out:
        rest = dict((k, v) for k, v in out.items() if k != 'ok')
        if set(rest) <= {'epoch'}:
            return {'ok': True}
        return {'ok': True, 'epoch': out.get('epoch')}
    return out


def case_status(name, events, want_status, **kw):
    got = run(req([job(events, **kw)]))
    got_s = {'results': [{'events': [status(o) for o in r['events']]} for r in got['results']]}
    want_s = {'results': [{'events': want_status}]} if 'events' in (want_status or {}) and False else None
    check(name, got_s, {'results': [{'events': want_status}]})
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
